item.text: {"0":"Across all four datasets, add a residual feed-forward block to each GRU output before the unchanged causal pooling: h'=h+W2(GELU(W1(h))), with hidden width 128, W1 Xavier initialized and W2 zero initialized. This starts with the incumbent state transformation while allowing nonlinear refinement within one jointly trained GRU4Rec model per category. Preserve embeddings, pooling, scoring, loss, optimizer and training settings; synchronize checkpoint architecture and predictor writer.","1":"Across all four datasets, change only the causal readout blend from 0.8*h_t+0.2*m_t to 0.85*h_t+0.15*m_t, retaining the three-interaction exponential half-life. A smaller pooled contribution may retain the benefit of broader interests while improving immediate next-item specificity. Exclude padding and future states, retain final-real-position inference, and preserve truncation, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer. Update predictor writer and readout metadata consistently.","2":"Across all four datasets, scale each real history item's existing input embedding by 1+0.05*log1p(c_i)/log1p(max_j c_j), using counts computed exclusively from supplied training interactions. Mildly amplifying frequent observed items may strengthen reliable recurrent context; the previous attenuation trial motivates testing the opposite direction. Keep padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. Preserve learned embedding design, topology, readout, loss and optimizer; save counts with each category's model and reproduce scaling through the predictor writer.","3":"Across all four datasets, replace only the pairwise term softplus(s_neg-s_pos) with softplus(s_neg-s_pos+0.1), retaining the 0.2 pointwise coefficient and uniform valid-position averaging. A small positive margin may improve ranking separation without the positional weighting or pointwise-coefficient changes that previously regressed. Preserve features, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, readout, optimizer, negative sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings. Train and load one checkpoint per category."}
